The cost caveating is consistently carried through.", "criteria_scores": {"report_writer.coherent_story": "5"}}

result.content: {"reasoning":"The narrative is tightly organized and coherent throughout. The headline correctly asserts that no tested configuration clears both gates, which directly follows from the gate criteria (97% pass rate in every task, p95 <= 600 ms). Claims c1 and c2 logically develop this premise, explaining that only two arms (Brisk-S and Atlas-M with high reasoning and 1 retry) pass quality across all tasks, but both violate the 600 ms latency budget overall. The tables and charts directly support the narrative flow without internal contradictions.","criteria_scores":{"report_writer.coherent_story":"5"}}

Every statement matches the data tables in its respective block without internal contradictions. Minor minor quibbles noted in the review findings (e.g., rounding differences like +0.7 vs +0.6, or omitting an interval for the Nano-to-Brisk step) do not break the story coherence.","criteria_scores":{"report_writer.coherent_story":"5"}}
